name: pair-signed-out-qr
prompt: On desktop Firefox with pairing v2 on, if I'm signed out and go to /pair, I still get a QR code. When I scan it with my phone, the approve page crashes with "Account data not loaded from localStorage". Signed-out people should be sent to sign in first. Can you fix it?

rubric.text: 2: Pair/Index sends a v2 desktop to scan_qr before it checks for a signed-in account, and the QR side needs no account, so the failure shows only after the scan. 1: it finds the early redirect but not the order problem. 0: wrong cause.
One point each: a signed-out v2 desktop goes to sign-in; a verified signed-in v2 desktop still reaches scan_qr; an unverified session goes to sign-in, as in v1.

One point each: tests cover signed-out and signed-in v2; a test covers a status answer that comes late (the gate can change while the sign-in check runs) or it explains why that case is safe; it ran the Pair Index tests and they pass.

1: no change unrelated to this bug. Tests for this bug in any package, unit or functional, are in scope; unrelated edits or a broad rewrite are not. Formatting by the repo's prettier in a file the fix touches is in scope.
